description: Plugin-driven item settings. snake_case canonical keys only, resolved against ItemSettingsModifiers in CraftEngine 26.8.

settings.name: repairable
settings.description: Allow anvil repair; mapping form carries repair rules.

settings.name: keep_on_death_chance
settings.description: Probability of keeping item on death (0..1).

settings.name: prevent_break
settings.description: Do not destroy on durability exhaustion.

settings.name: anvil_repair_item
settings.description: Anvil repair rules: list of {target, amount, percent}.

settings.name: drag_repair_item
settings.description: Drag repair rules: list of {target, amount, percent, sound}.

settings.name: break_power
settings.description: Tool break power. Vanilla: wood/gold=1, stone/copper=2, iron=3, diamond=4, netherite=5, other=0.

settings.name: equipment
settings.description: Reference to a registered equipment asset by asset_id.

settings.name: food
settings.description: Plugin-side food fallback (prefer data components on 1.20.5+); {nutrition, saturation}.

settings.name: invulnerable
settings.description: Damage sources ignored by item entity.

settings.name: ingredient_substitute
settings.description: Items substituted for this item in recipes.

settings.name: fuel_remainder
settings.description: Returned item after fuel consumption (stack size 1).

settings.name: allowed_projectiles
settings.description: Allowed projectile item ids for bows/crossbows.

non_canonical_camelcase_warning: fuelTime, maxStackSize and similar camelCase forms are NOT canonical YAML syntax.
